title: Choose the visual world for the guide pages
question: The roll assigned Safety Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Sketches show the Meta guide's first viewport on a phone; gray bars stand in for copy.

options.label: Safety Card
options.thesis: Every step is a panel you cannot misread, built for someone on a phone who has never done this before.
options.viewport: Red header band with the title in bold condensed caps, a pictogram row of what you need, then step 1 as a full-width panel with a monumental numeral and the command inside it. The Skool strip is a hazard-striped band at the bottom.
options.risk: Reads as parody if the pictogram language is decorative instead of doing real work; screenshots and commands must live inside the panels.

options.label: Napkin Zine
options.thesis: The guide as a friend sketching it for you: marker headings, doodle arrows, highlighter on the one line that matters.
options.case: Fuses well with Roman's conversational voice. Risk: marker lettering on a phone, and the hand-drawn devices can tip into cringe if overused.

options.label: Carousel Slides
options.thesis: One idea per slide, huge numerals, the exact format the reader consumes every day in the app they came from.
options.case: Strongest audience identification of the set. Risk: long steps with code fight the one-idea-per-slide rule, and a dark app frame can feel heavy for reading.

options.label: Agency SOP
options.thesis: The guide as a live standard operating procedure from Roman's own agency: checklist first, numbered procedure, tabbed by topic.
options.case: Carries the 'steal my automations' promise literally. Risk: can read as bureaucratic if the paper cues are heavy; the tab rail must do real navigation.

options.label: Monochrome Product Page
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white, one accent used sparingly, every step paired with a screenshot that proves it.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and reads clearly, but it is close to the incumbent look and the category default. Wins clarity, loses identification.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean docs page: white ground, one accent, numbered steps, code blocks, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Header bar, title, subtitle, prerequisites, numbered steps with code, FAQ, footer CTA. What every guide site ships, at full craft.
